title: How effective are traditional test criteria at detecting bugs in large language models generated code?
abstract: arXiv:2609.09315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test adequacy criteria are widely used to evaluate and guide software testing. Although prior research has extensively examined these criteria using human-written programs, faults, and tests, the increasing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation raises important questions about their effectiveness in detecting LLM-induced faults. To investigate this, we conduct an empirical study involving 5 LLMs and 4 benchmarks, simulating end-to-end workflows in which both code and tests are automatically generated. We collect 6,000+ faulty program instances and evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of 3 widely used adequacy criteria: statement coverage, branch coverage, and mutation testing. Our findings reveal several key insights. First, most faults introduced by LLMs are relatively trivial to catch. Second, the challenging faults are difficult to trigger using either traditional coverage-based or mutation-based criteria.

translated_title: 传统测试准则在检测大语言模型生成代码中的缺陷方面效果如何？
translated_abstract: 测试充分性准则被广泛用于评估和指导软件测试。尽管先前的研究已经使用人工编写的程序、缺陷和测试对这些准则进行了广泛考察，但大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成中的日益普及引发了关于其在检测LLM引入缺陷方面有效性的重要问题。为了研究这一点，我们开展了一项涉及5个大语言模型和4个基准测试的实证研究，模拟了代码和测试均自动生成的端到端工作流程。我们收集了6000多个有缺陷的程序实例，并评估了3种广泛使用的充分性准则——语句覆盖、分支覆盖和变异测试——的有效性和效率。我们的发现揭示了几个关键见解：首先，LLM引入的大多数缺陷相对容易被捕获；其次，具有挑战性的缺陷无论使用传统的基于覆盖率的准则还是基于变异的准则都难以触发。
tldr: 该实证研究表明，传统测试充分性准则（语句覆盖、分支覆盖和变异测试）可以较容易地捕获LLM生成代码中的大多数缺陷，但对于具有挑战性的缺陷则难以有效触发。
en_tdlr: An empirical study involving 5 LLMs and 4 benchmarks shows that traditional test adequacy criteria can easily catch most LLM-introduced faults, but the challenging faults remain difficult to trigger using coverage-based or mutation-based criteria.
